theTest: Graph Intel v2.2 — the deep-host-testing suite (Phase 0-4)
theRig: the LIVE host — the deployed extension at ~/.omp/agent/extensions/graph-intelligence/index.js

theScenarios.what: the V2.2 symbols in the bundle

theScenarios.passToken: a NAMED refusal (never a silent empty)

theScenarios.what: the negative — a legit read on a fresh store
theScenarios.observed: the register reads 4/8; the corbell layer CONSUMED (the populated_at gate: fresh, 80s old)

theFindings.theMechanism: the register's corbell probe gates on gi_meta.populated_at vs the TTL (1h) → FRESH; the extension's graph-query gates on isCorbellCheckoutFreshFor — an mtime-walk with a FILE BUDGET over the target tree → the GI repo's huge tree (Checkpoints/Ship_Packages/node_modules) exhausts the budget → stale-budget. The SAME store reads fresh on one path and stale on the other.
theFindings.theImpact: a graph-query on a large repo refuses with CORBELL_NOT_WARM:stale while the register reads the layer as CONSUMED. Both are LOUD (never a silent empty) — the defect is the INCONSISTENCY, not a fake.
theFindings.theDisposition: LOGGED (a candidate fix: the query path adopts the populated_at gate, or the walk skips the same dirs the discovery skips)

theVerdict: PASS with one logged finding — the deploy is verified (the SHA parity + the symbols + the wiring); the tool surface registers + executes; every refusal is NAMED (never a silent empty); the register reads 4/8 with every other layer named. The capability is proven on the HOST (the register 7/8 on the GI repo, 3/8 on a foreign target, from the earlier runs).
theHonestGaps: the audit gate is BLOCKED (degraded — the lane rate-limited; 0 critical, 136 high) → the ship-ready claim is withheld
the container cannot self-populate (a bare env)
HF-1: the two freshness criteria disagree on a large repo
